bus_policy.cite: Gamebloke project policy: one master cycle per raw request; no WAITCNT or prefetch timing claim.

initialization_policy.cite: Gamebloke deterministic project policy: zero initialize state; hardware power-on RAM values remain unknown.

cpu_policy.cite: Gamebloke deterministic project policy: direct-start CPU initialization, one preflighted interpreter path, and explicit BIOS-none exception stops.
cpu_policy.architecture_cite: ARM7TDMI Technical Reference Manual (DDI 0029G, Issue G), ARM state, Thumb state, and processor modes sections.
cpu_policy.register_banks: User/System share r8-r14, FIQ has private r8-r14, IRQ/SVC/ABT/UND each have private r13-r14, and FIQ/IRQ/SVC/ABT/UND have SPSRs.
supported_opcode_operands: ARM data processing: MOV, ADD, SUB, CMP, AND, ORR, rotated immediate or register operand, immediate or register-specified LSL/LSR/ASR/ROR, S flag supported, destinations r0-r14
ARM control flow: B, BL, BX
ARM single transfer: LDR/STR byte or word, immediate 12-bit offset, pre-indexed, no writeback, U plus or minus, r0-r14 base/data, PC base only for positive LDR literal
Thumb data processing: MOV immediate8, ADD/SUB immediate8, CMP immediate8
Thumb high-register operations: MOV to r0-r14 and BX
Thumb control flow: conditional B except SWI/reserved conditions, and unconditional B
Thumb transfer: PC-relative word LDR at aligned(current+4), plus immediate word/byte LDR/STR using low registers
excluded_opcode_operands: ARM register-specified shifts involving r15, r15 destinations other than branch/BX, STR with PC source, and PC reads
ARM post-indexed or writeback transfers, halfword/signed transfers, block transfers, multiply, swap, full PSR transfers, and coprocessor execution
Thumb data-processing writes to r15 outside BX/branch, Thumb BL pair, and non-listed transfer forms
All other valid-but-unimplemented opcodes and operands stop as unsupported, reserved undefined encodings remain distinct
Later ARM architecture extensions and every instruction family absent from the supported array

read_policy.cite: Unverified Gamebloke project behavior: current-latch placeholders for absent BIOS, unsupported I/O, and ROM tails.

unmodeled.reason: Differences between the original console, the SP, and the Micro are not modeled in v1.0. The profile id is agb only; no result may claim behavior of an SP or a Micro.
details: The Internal Memory Control register at 0x04000800 sets the EWRAM wait states; its fastest setting is reported to lock up the Micro (REF, GBATEK, section 4000800h Internal Memory Control).
The Micro has no cartridge switch (REF, GBATEK, section GBA Backwards Compatibility CGB Mode).

unmodeled.reason: The cartridge prefetch buffer is not emulated in v1.0; no result may claim cartridge wait-state or prefetch timing.

Sources disagree on the cycle at which the HBlank flag changes: values of 1,006, 1,007, and 1,008 cycles appear in different sources, and 960 is the visible drawing time, not the flag edge. The profile carries no number for it.
